section_summary.extract_value: This introduction describes the development of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revision (BAS-2), and motivates evaluating the Persian BAS-2. The present study aims to examine the factor structure, convergent validity, and internal consistency of the BAS-2 in Iran and hypothesizes that BAS-2 scores will be negatively correlated with BMI and higher among men than women.

Moreover, sex differences were evaluated and, in line with previous research, it was hypothesized that men would have significantly higher scores of body appreciation compared with women."
